title: Resilient Multi-Agent Negotiation for Medical Supply Chains: Integrating LLMs and Blockchain for Transparent Coordination
reasoning: The paper integrates ethical reasoning as a functional component of its system architecture, specifically through 'Ethical tools' and 'Ethical Logic' designed to handle triage and fair resource allocation. It evaluates the framework using a specific 'Fairness' metric to ensure equitable distribution during medical crises.
